Cyber Security

Data loss prevention, XDR/EDR, email security, privileged access and vulnerability management.

See it in action

  • Phishing mail quarantined at the email gateway
  • Exploit attempt dropped by the firewall
  • Ransomware stopped and host isolated by EDR/XDR
  • DLP blocks the exfiltration; SOC investigates the alerts

Illustrative simulation of a typical scenario. Not live customer data.

How we deliver it

We layer prevention and detection: data, endpoints, email, identity and privileged accounts are each protected, and alerts feed an investigation and response process.

  1. Assess: risk review, configuration and identity audit
  2. Protect: DLP, endpoint, email and privileged access controls
  3. Detect: XDR, EDR and managed detection and response
  4. Respond: containment, root-cause analysis and remediation tracking

Outcomes

  • Less sensitive data leaving the business
  • Faster detection and response
  • Controlled, audited privileged access

What we do

  • Forcepoint DLP policies across endpoints: data classification, flow analysis and incident handling
  • Taegis XDR, Sophos MDR, SentinelOne and Kaspersky EDR: policy creation, access restrictions and automated response
  • Microsoft Defender and Check Point email security against phishing, malware and spam
  • Azure Information Protection: sensitivity labels and auto-labeling rules
  • BeyondTrust Password Safe: privileged access policies, credential rotation and audit
  • Review regulator and audit findings and track remediation to closure
  • CVSS-based vulnerability management and system hardening
